records.translation: **归因图不是解释。** 它只是某个过程产生的逐像素数值。它不能显示模型 "looked at" 了什么，不能证明被突出显示的像素导致了预测，而且对于权重随机的模型它同样会生成看似合理的图。本模块提供四种检查，用于判断一张图是否反映了模型：

records.source: :func:`deletion_curve` / :func:`insertion_curve` — remove (or add) the pixels the map ranks highest and watch the score. A map whose deletion curve is flat is not describing what the model uses, however good it looks.

records.label: spacr.attribution#10
records.source: **Two head shapes, one contract.** A spaCR classifier's head emits either one logit (binary; class 1 when the logit is positive) or ``C`` logits. Code that assumes one shape is wrong for the other, and silently so: attributing the raw logit of a single-logit head always explains *class 1*, so for an image the model called class 0 the map you get is the map for the class it rejected — the negation of what you asked for. Every method here goes through :class:`ClassScoreModel`, which presents a single logit ``z`` as the two-column view ``[-z, +z]``. Both classes then have a real gradient, ``target`` means the same thing for both head shapes, and no caller has to know which head it has.
records.context: **Two head shapes, one contract.** A spaCR machine-learning classification model's head emits either one logit (binary; class 1 when the logit is positive) or ``C`` logits. Code that assumes one shape is wrong for the other, and silently so: attributing the raw logit of a single-logit head always explains *class 1*, so for an image the model called class 0 the map you get is the map for the class it rejected — the negation of what you asked for. Every method here goes through :class:`ClassScoreModel`, which presents a single logit ``z`` as the two-column view ``[-z, +z]``. Both classes then have a real gradient, ``target`` means the same thing for both head shapes, and no caller has to know which head it has.
records.translation: **两种头形状，一份约定。** spaCR 分类器的头要么输出一个 logit（二分类；logit 为正时为类别 1），要么输出 ``C`` 个 logit。假定其中一种形状的代码对另一种是错误的，而且是悄无声息地错误：对单 logit 头的原始 logit 做归因总是在解释 *类别 1*，因此对于模型判为类别 0 的图像，得到的图是它所拒绝的那个类别的图——与你所要求的正好相反。这里的每种方法都经过 :class:`ClassScoreModel`，它把单个 logit ``z`` 呈现为两列视图 ``[-z, +z]``。这样两个类别都有真实的梯度，``target`` 对两种头形状含义相同，调用者也无需知道自己使用的是哪种头。

records.label: spacr.attribution.smoothgrad#0

records.context: SmoothGrad: average ``base_method`` over ``n_samples`` noisy copies.

records.label: spacr.attribution.smoothgrad#1
records.source: Gradient maps are visually noisy because the gradient of a ReLU network fluctuates sharply between neighbouring inputs. Averaging over Gaussian perturbations of the input suppresses that fluctuation as ``1/sqrt(n)`` while keeping the structure that survives perturbation.
records.context: Gradient maps are visually noisy because the gradient of a ReLU network fluctuates sharply between neighbouring inputs. Averaging over Gaussian perturbations of the input suppresses that fluctuation as ``1/sqrt(n)`` while keeping the structure that survives perturbation.
records.translation: 梯度图在视觉上有噪声，因为 ReLU 网络的梯度在相邻输入之间剧烈波动。对输入的高斯扰动取平均，会按 ``1/sqrt(n)`` 抑制这种波动，同时保留经得起扰动的结构。

records.label: spacr.attribution.smoothgrad#2
records.source: For the captum-backed methods this is captum's own ``NoiseTunnel``. The CAM family and rollout are not captum attributors, so for those the averaging is done here over re-runs of the adapter — same definition, applied to the map.
records.context: For the captum-backed methods this is captum's own ``NoiseTunnel``. The CAM family and rollout are not captum attributors, so for those the averaging is done here over re-runs of the adapter — same definition, applied to the map.
records.translation: 对基于 captum 的方法，这是 captum 自带的 ``NoiseTunnel``。CAM 族和 rollout 不是 captum 归因器，因此对它们而言，平均是在这里通过重新运行适配器完成的——定义相同，只是应用在图上。

records.label: spacr.attribution.smoothgrad#3
records.source: Smoothing makes a map *look* better. It does not make it more faithful, and a smoothed map that still fails :func:`randomization_sanity_check` fails it just as badly.
records.context: Smoothing makes a map *look* better. It does not make it more faithful, and a smoothed map that still fails :func:`randomization_sanity_check` fails it just as badly.
records.translation: 平滑让图 *看起来* 更好。它不会让图更忠实，而且一张仍然通不过 :func:`randomization_sanity_check` 的平滑图同样会失败得很彻底。

records.label: spacr.attribution.smoothgrad#6
records.source: any key of :data:`ATTRIBUTION_METHODS`.
records.context: any key of :data:`ATTRIBUTION_METHODS`.
records.translation: :data:`ATTRIBUTION_METHODS` 的任意键。

records.label: spacr.ops_merge#0
records.source: Match cells between two magnifications by their arrangement, not their pixels.
records.context: Match cells between two magnifications by their arrangement, not their pixels.
records.translation: 按排列方式而不是像素，在两种放大倍率之间匹配细胞。

records.label: spacr.ops_merge#1
records.source: Optical pooled screening images the same well twice: once at low magnification to read the barcodes, once at high magnification to measure the phenotype. Every cell must be matched between the two, and the obvious method -- correlate the images -- does not work. The pixels do not correspond: the scale differs, the stains differ, and often the microscope differs too.
records.context: Optical pooled screening images the same well twice: once at low magnification to read the barcodes, once at high magnification to measure the phenotype. Every cell must be matched between the two, and the obvious method -- correlate the images -- does not work. The pixels do not correspond: the scale differs, the stains differ, and often the microscope differs too.
records.translation: 光学混合筛选（optical pooled screening）对同一个孔成像两次：一次用低放大倍率读取条形码，一次用高放大倍率测量表型。每个细胞都必须在两者之间匹配，而显而易见的方法——对图像做相关——行不通。像素并不对应：尺度不同，染色不同，往往连显微镜也不同。

records.label: spacr.ops_merge#2
records.source: What is preserved is the arrangement of the cells. Take three neighbouring cells and the shape of the triangle they form is unchanged by magnification, rotation and translation. So the cells are triangulated, each triangle is reduced to a descriptor that depends only on its shape, and the two sets are matched on those descriptors. The transform between the acquisitions falls out of the matched triangles, and the cells are paired under it.
records.context: What is preserved is the arrangement of the cells. Take three neighbouring cells and the shape of the triangle they form is unchanged by magnification, rotation and translation. So the cells are triangulated, each triangle is reduced to a descriptor that depends only on its shape, and the two sets are matched on those descriptors. The transform between the acquisitions falls out of the matched triangles, and the cells are paired under it.
records.translation: 被保留下来的是细胞的排列。取三个相邻细胞，它们构成的三角形的形状不会因放大、旋转和平移而改变。因此对细胞做三角剖分，把每个三角形归约为只取决于其形状的描述符，并按这些描述符匹配两个集合。两次采集之间的变换由匹配的三角形得出，细胞则在该变换下配对。

records.label: spacr.ops_merge#3
records.source: Matching is mutual nearest neighbour with a distance limit: a pair is kept only when each cell is the other's nearest, and anything doubtful is dropped rather than assigned. A wrongly matched cell gives a real phenotype the wrong barcode, which silently corrupts a screen; a dropped one costs only statistical power, which more cells can buy back.
records.context: Matching is mutual nearest neighbour with a distance limit: a pair is kept only when each cell is the other's nearest, and anything doubtful is dropped rather than assigned. A wrongly matched cell gives a real phenotype the wrong barcode, which silently corrupts a screening experiment; a dropped one costs only statistical detection sensitivity, which more cells can buy back.
records.translation: 匹配采用带距离限制的互为最近邻：只有当每个细胞都是对方的最近者时才保留这一对，任何可疑的都被丢弃而不是被分配。错误匹配的细胞会给真实表型赋予错误的条形码，从而悄悄破坏一次筛选；被丢弃的细胞只损失统计功效，而更多的细胞可以把它买回来。

records.source: The last row is a failure and is recorded as one. Triangle shape is what carries the signal, and jitter of a few pixels on a cell a few tens of pixels across changes that shape materially -- so the method degrades with centroid noise rather than with cell count. If a real acquisition sits nearer the last row than the fourth, the answer is better segmentation centroids, not a looser tolerance: widening the tolerance admits more coincidental shape matches and moves the median onto them.
records.context: The last row is a failure and is recorded as one. records.translation: 最后一行是一次失败，并被记录为失败。承载信号的是三角形的形状，而在几十像素宽的细胞上几个像素的抖动会实质性地改变该形状——因此这种方法随质心噪声而退化，而不是随细胞数量。如果某次真实采集更接近最后一行而不是第四行，答案是更好的分割质心，而不是更宽松的容差：放宽容差会放进更多巧合的形状匹配，并使中位数向它们移动。

records.label: spacr.ops_merge.align_by_triangles#0

records.label: spacr.ops_merge.align_by_triangles#1
records.source: Every triangle in ``source`` is matched to the ``target`` triangles whose shape descriptor is within ``tolerance``, each match proposes a transform, and the proposals are pooled. Pooling is what makes this robust: a single coincidental shape match proposes a wrong transform, but wrong proposals disagree with each other while right ones agree, so the median survives and the outliers do not.
records.context: Every triangle in ``source`` is matched to the ``target`` triangles whose shape descriptor is within ``tolerance``, each match proposes a transform, and the proposals are pooled. Pooling is what makes this robust: a single coincidental shape match proposes a wrong transform, but wrong proposals disagree with each other while right ones agree, so the median survives and the outliers do not.
records.translation: ``source`` 中的每个三角形都与 ``target`` 中形状描述符在 ``tolerance`` 之内的三角形匹配，每个匹配提出一个变换，这些提议被汇集。汇集使其稳健：单个巧合的形状匹配会提出错误的变换，但错误的提议彼此不一致，而正确的提议彼此一致，因此中位数得以保留而离群值不会。

records.label: spacr.ops_merge.triangle_descriptors#0
records.source: Delaunay-triangulate ``points`` and describe each triangle by its shape.
records.context: Delaunay-triangulate ``points`` and describe each triangle by its shape.
records.translation: 对 ``points`` 做 Delaunay 三角剖分，并以形状描述每个三角形。

records.label: spacr.ops_merge.triangle_descriptors#1
records.source: The descriptor is two numbers: the ratios of the two shorter sides to the longest. Scaling a triangle multiplies every side by the same factor, so the ratios do not move; rotating and translating it does not change side lengths at all. The descriptor therefore ignores absolute size and position, which are what differ between the two acquisitions.
records.context: The descriptor is two numbers: the ratios of the two shorter sides to the longest. Scaling a triangle multiplies every side by the same factor, so the ratios do not move; rotating and translating it does not change side lengths at all. The descriptor therefore ignores absolute size and position, which are what differ between the two acquisitions.
records.translation: 描述符是两个数：较短的两条边与最长边之比。缩放三角形会把每条边乘以同一个因子，因此比值不变；旋转和平移则完全不改变边长。因此描述符忽略绝对大小和位置，而这两者正是两次采集之间不同的地方。

records.source: ``(N, 2)`` cell centroids.
records.context: ``(N, 2)`` cell centroids.

That ordering is what makes two matched descriptors also give matched points, without which the transform cannot be solved.
records.context: ``(descriptors, vertex_indices)`` -- an ``(M, 2)`` array and the ``(M, 3)`` indices of each triangle's vertices, ordered so that vertex 0 is opposite the shortest side and vertex 2 opposite the longest. That ordering is what makes two matched descriptors also give matched points, without which the transform cannot be solved.

records.label: spacr.ops_objects#1
records.source: Segment, sew, number -- the three steps between a composite and an object table. The compose step gives a mosaic that is built a window at a time and never materialised whole; this is what segmentation and numbering do on top of it:
records.context: Segment, sew, number -- the three steps between a composite and an object table. The compose step gives a stitched image grid that is built a window at a time and never materialised whole; this is what segmentation and numbering do on top of it:
records.translation: 分割、缝合、编号——合成图与对象表之间的三个步骤。合成步骤给出一个每次构建一个窗口、从不整体具现的镶嵌图；分割和编号在其之上进行：

records.label: spacr.ops_objects#2
records.source: Segment once, on the composite, window by window.
records.context: Segment once, on the composite, window by window.
records.translation: 在合成图上逐窗口分割一次。

records.context: Sew the labels across window seams. An object straddling a boundary is one object, matched on its well-frame centroid.

records.label: spacr.ops_objects#4
records.source: Number in the well frame, not per window. Per-window numbering would give two windows an object #1 apiece.
records.context: Number in the microplate sample position frame, not per window. Per-window numbering would give two windows an object #1 apiece.

records.label: spacr.ops_objects#5
records.source: The compose step already handles half of the seam problem: :func:`spacr.ops_compose.windows_over` tiles with an overlap, and its contract is that the overlap exceeds the largest object. So a nucleus near a seam is not split between two windows -- it is seen whole by at least one of them, and usually twice. The job here is therefore deduplication, not reconstruction: find the observations that are the same nucleus and keep the one that saw all of it.
records.context: The compose step already handles half of the seam problem: :func:`spacr.ops_compose.windows_over` microscope image fields with an overlap, and its contract is that the overlap exceeds the largest object. So a nucleus near a seam is not split between two windows -- it is seen whole by at least one of them, and usually twice. The job here is therefore deduplication, not reconstruction: find the observations that are the same nucleus and keep the one that saw all of it.
records.translation: 合成步骤已经处理了接缝问题的一半：:func:`spacr.ops_compose.windows_over` 以重叠方式分块，其约定是重叠大于最大的对象。因此接缝附近的细胞核不会被分到两个窗口——至少有一个窗口会完整地看到它，通常是两个。所以这里的工作是去重，而不是重建：找出属于同一个细胞核的观测，保留完整看到它的那一个。

records.label: spacr.ops_objects#6
records.source: Reconstructing an object from two partial masks means deciding how to union pixels across a seam, which is fiddly and lossy. Choosing between two complete masks is neither.
records.context: Reconstructing an object from two partial masks means deciding how to union pixels across a seam, which is fiddly and lossy. Choosing between two complete masks is neither.
records.translation: 从两个局部掩码重建一个对象，意味着要决定如何跨接缝合并像素，这既繁琐又有损。在两个完整的掩码之间选择则两者皆非。

records.label: spacr.ops_objects#7
records.source: One failure remains and is reported: an object larger than the overlap, which every window clips. :func:`number` refuses those rather than emitting a fragment, because a fragment looks exactly like a small nucleus and would be counted as one for the rest of the run.
records.context: One failure remains and is reported: an object larger than the overlap, which every window clips. :func:`number` refuses those rather than emitting a fragment, because a fragment looks exactly like a small nucleus and would be counted as one for the rest of the processing session.
records.translation: 还剩一种失败并会被报告：比重叠更大的对象，每个窗口都会裁切它。:func:`number` 拒绝这些对象而不是发出碎片，因为碎片看起来恰如一个小细胞核，会在其余运行中被当作细胞核计数。

records.label: spacr.ops_objects#8
records.source: The ids are a join key, so they are assigned deterministically -- raster order on the well-frame centroid -- and not by iteration order over a dict or by whichever window happened to be segmented first. The contract is: "This id, and the centroid beside it, is the join key for every later phase." Two runs over the same data must produce the same numbers or nothing downstream can be compared.
records.context: The ids are a join structured-data name, so they are assigned deterministically -- raster order on the microplate sample position-frame centroid -- and not by iteration order over a key-value mapping or by whichever window happened to be segmented first. records.source: Read-only UI housekeeping (``journal=False`` — a history refresh, a model scan) is cancelled and waited for exactly like everything else, but it never appears in the return value. It writes nothing, so there is no half-written artefact to protect, and a caller that treats it as a veto turns "the run-history list is still loading" into "the application cannot be closed". ``MainWindow.closeEvent`` answers a non-empty return by refusing to close *and showing a modal*: on a headless run — CI, a test shard — nothing can ever dismiss that modal, and the process spins in its nested event loop with no forward progress. A housekeeping job that outlived the screen which started it used to be enough to trigger it.
records.context: Read-only UI housekeeping (``journal=False`` — a history refresh, a model scan) is cancelled and waited for exactly like everything else, but it never appears in the return value. A housekeeping job that outlived the screen which started it used to be enough to trigger it.
records.translation: 只读的 UI 清理工作（``journal=False``——历史刷新、模型扫描）与其他所有工作一样被取消和等待，但它从不出现在返回值中。它不写入任何内容，因此没有写到一半的产物需要保护，而把它当作否决的调用者会把“运行历史列表仍在加载”变成“应用程序无法关闭”。``MainWindow.closeEvent`` 对非空返回值的回应是拒绝关闭 *并显示一个模态对话框*：在无头运行——CI、测试分片——中没有任何东西能关闭该模态对话框，进程就在其嵌套的事件循环中空转而没有进展。过去，一个比启动它的界面存活得更久的清理作业就足以触发这种情况。

records.source: A widget's QSS font is resolved when it is polished, which for a screen built into a stacked page happens on the way to the first show. Measuring here as well as on the font change is what keeps a row that was never sent a font change -- because its own font was inherited whole -- from being sized by the default metrics.
records.context: A widget's QSS font is resolved when it is polished, which for an application view built into a stacked page happens on the way to the first show. Measuring here as well as on the font change is what keeps a row that was never sent a font change -- because its own font was inherited whole -- from being sized by the default metrics.
records.translation: 控件的 QSS 字体在其被润色时解析，对于嵌入堆叠页面的界面，这发生在首次显示的途中。除了在字体变化时测量之外，这里也测量，可以防止从未收到字体变化的一行——因为它自己的字体是整体继承的——按默认度量来确定大小。

records.label: spacr.restart_state#1
records.source: The restart record stores the current module, its settings, a summary of active runs, and the locations of any run folders. :func:`save` verifies the record before the current process exits, and :func:`take` consumes it when the new process starts so that stale state is not restored repeatedly.
records.context: The restart record stores the current module, its settings, a summary of active runs, and the locations of any processing-session folders. :func:`save` verifies the record before the current process exits, and :func:`take` consumes it when the new process starts so that stale state is not restored repeatedly.
records.translation: 重启记录存储当前模块、其设置、活动运行的摘要以及所有运行文件夹的位置。:func:`save` 在当前进程退出前验证该记录，:func:`take` 在新进程启动时消耗它，这样过期状态就不会被反复恢复。

records.label: spacr.restart_state#2
records.source: Only the interface configuration is restored. Active computations do not resume after a forced restart; output written before the restart remains in the recorded run folders.
records.context: Only the interface configuration is restored. Active computations do not resume after a forced restart; output written before the restart remains in the recorded processing-session folders.
records.translation: 只恢复界面配置。强制重启后活动计算不会恢复；重启之前写入的输出保留在记录的运行文件夹中。
